Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the test, indicating potential issues that need immediate attention. It is recommended to investigate the page's resources, scripts, and images to identify the cause of the delay and optimize them accordingly.
insights: The pricing and blog pages have faster load times, indicating effective optimization of resources, scripts, and images.
The Time to First Byte (TTFB) metric is relatively low across all pages, suggesting that the server response time is good.
First Contentful Paint (FCP) is also low across all pages, indicating that the pages are rendering quickly and providing a good user experience.
